gpuPolicy.firstPass: Run ready 1xH100 experiments first; promote only high-signal winners to 8xH100 record attempts.
gpuPolicy.batching: Queue is CPU-generated and GPU-consumed by one command so GPU time is spent only on selected runnable experiments. This queue is not capped; ticket/status lane inventory caps live in Fastest planning policy, not the GPU execution backlog.
gpuPolicy.quality: External Parameter Golf code remains subject to security and maintainability review; queueing optimizes idle GPU time, not quality gates.
gpuPolicy.parallelPods: To split independent work across rented GPUs, run the same command with --shard-count N and a distinct --shard-index per pod; the queue remains uncapped.

researchSources.title: Rigging the Lottery: Making All Tickets Winners
researchSources.idea: Dynamic sparse training can update sparse topology with infrequent dense-gradient information while keeping parameter and compute budgets fixed.

researchSources.title: Dynamic Sparse Training with Structured Sparsity
researchSources.idea: Structured RigL learns fine-grained structured sparsity that is more likely to map to real hardware speedups than unstructured sparsity.

researchSources.title: Asynchronous Local-SGD Training for Language Modeling
researchSources.idea: Local-SGD reduces synchronization dependencies; delayed momentum and speed-adjusted local steps protect convergence under asynchronous workers.

researchSources.title: BLaST: High Performance Inference and Pretraining using BLock Sparse Transformers
researchSources.idea: Block-sparse linear layers can reduce data movement and MLP compute while preserving model quality if kernels and block layouts are hardware-aligned.

researchSources.title: Qsparse-local-SGD: Distributed SGD with Quantization, Sparsification and Local Computations
researchSources.idea: Compression plus local computation is a communication-throughput direction for distributed training.
